post.description:
Stream a run: `run_started`, `guard`, `hypotheses_registered`, steps, blocks,
`answer` (or `error`), and always `done` last. If the run needs the user it sends
`clarification_needed` then `done{status: waiting_user}`; continue with `/reply`.

`thread_id` must come from an earlier `run_started` for this user (404 otherwise).

200.description: Server-sent events, one StreamEvent per message; `done` is last.

400.description: Invalid area, thread id or X-User-Id.

404.description: Thread not found for this user.

post.description:
Accept the answers (only keys that were asked), save them to the place profile when
`remember`, then stream the same run: `clarification_answered` first (also stored in
the event log), then steps, blocks, `answer`, and `done` last.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: 'place' = about an area (shows 'Keep watching'); 'general' = no area, shows `suggested_skills` instead.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline, e.g. 'About 4.6 ha of the ponds are now dry'.

eyebrow.title: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: Small label above the title, e.g. place name.

color.title: Color
color.description: Colour square next to the eyebrow.

cause.title: Cause
cause.description: Likely cause in plain words; None for measure-only answers.

measure_only.title: Measure Only
measure_only.description: True when no knowledge card matched.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: True when served from cached/stub preset data.

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description:
The final answer for a run.

Frontend mapping (src/data/agent.ts `Answer`): same names, except `skill_id` → `skillId`
and `suggested_skills` → `suggested`. Fields the frontend does not show yet (`sentence`,
`blocks`, `followups`, `method`, ...) are extra.

Area.title: Area
Area.description: A place outline in WGS84 (lon/lat GeoJSON geometry), with its true area in hectares.

geojson.title: Geojson
geojson.description: GeoJSON Polygon, MultiPolygon, Feature or FeatureCollection (lon/lat).

AreaInput.title: AreaInput
AreaInput.description: The area a question is about: exactly one of a GeoJSON outline or a point.

AreaMatch.title: AreaMatch
AreaMatch.description: One candidate place from a search.

query.title: Query
query.description: Place name, address or 'lat, lon' text.

link.title: Link
link.description: A map link (e.g. Google/OSM) containing coordinates.

AreaResolveRequest.title: AreaResolveRequest
AreaResolveRequest.description: Turn a search text, point, outline or map link into an area: exactly one field set.

AreaResolveResponse.title: AreaResolveResponse
AreaResolveResponse.description: The resolved area, how it was found, and other candidates for a search.

BlockReady.title: BlockReady
BlockReady.description: A visual block is ready to render.

header.title: Header
header.description: The validated card header, as JSON.

CardDetail.title: CardDetail
CardDetail.description: A full card: index entry, validated YAML header and Markdown body.

CardIndexEntry.title: CardIndexEntry
CardIndexEntry.description: One line of the knowledge index: an event or setting card.

CardRef.title: CardRef
CardRef.description: A knowledge card used by the method, pinned to a version.

remember.title: Remember
remember.description: Whether the answers were saved to the place profile.

ClarificationAnswered.title: ClarificationAnswered
ClarificationAnswered.description: The user answered the clarification card (first event of the reply stream).

ClarificationNeeded.title: ClarificationNeeded
ClarificationNeeded.description: The run is waiting for the user to answer questions.

ClarificationQuestion.title: ClarificationQuestion
ClarificationQuestion.description: One question for the user, optionally prefilled.

Confidence.title: Confidence
Confidence.description: How sure the answer is, with a one-line reason.

Cost.title: Cost
Cost.description: LLM token usage and cost for a run.

CreatePlaceRequest.title: CreatePlaceRequest
CreatePlaceRequest.description:
Send `geometry` (a GeoJSON polygon; `center` is then ignored and recomputed),
or `center` + `radius_m` for a dropped pin.

Done.title: Done
Done.description:
The stream ended (always its last event).

`waiting_user`: the run is paused on a `clarification_needed` card; continue it with
`POST /api/runs/{run_id}/reply`, which streams the rest of the run.

ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent
ErrorEvent.description: Something went wrong; `recoverable` says whether the run continues.

ExpectationRow.title: ExpectationRow
ExpectationRow.description: What a hypothesis predicts per measure, and what was observed.

rule_id.title: Rule Id
rule_id.description: Policy rule that fired, if any.

GuardEvent.title: GuardEvent
GuardEvent.description: The guard's verdict on whether the question can be answered.

post_hoc.title: Post Hoc
post_hoc.description: True if registered after the first data read.

HypothesesRegistered.title: HypothesesRegistered
HypothesesRegistered.description: Hypotheses registered before reading data (or after, when post_hoc).

Image.title: Image
Image.description: A rendered map image pinned to WGS84 bounds (from `earth.render`).

MemoryPatch.title: MemoryPatch
MemoryPatch.description: User edits on the Places page. The LLM never calls this.

code_ref.title: Code Ref
code_ref.description: Reference to the script that ran.

Method.title: Method
Method.description: What produced the answer: cards, skill and code reference.

PatchPlaceRequest.title: PatchPlaceRequest
PatchPlaceRequest.description:
Every field optional. Sending `geometry` (wins over `center`) or `center` + `radius_m`
replaces the outline.

PlaceContext.title: PlaceContext
PlaceContext.description: What `describe(area)` returns: enough to plan, without reading any satellite pixels twice.

PointInput.title: PointInput
PointInput.description: A point plus a radius; the area is the circle around it.

why.title: Why
why.description: Why it was skipped, when not used.

ProofScene.title: ProofScene
ProofScene.description: A satellite scene that was looked at, and whether it was used.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Where a number came from (HANDOFF B1.8). Attached to every result.

remember.title: Remember
remember.description: Save the answers to the place profile.

ReplyRequest.title: ReplyRequest
ReplyRequest.description: Answers to clarification questions, keyed by question key.

RouteOption.title: RouteOption
RouteOption.description: A data source considered for the question and what happened to it.

area.description: The area the run is about (stored once; None = demo preset).

RunRecord.title: RunRecord
RunRecord.description: Everything about a run, enough to replay it exactly (BUILD-PLAN I4).

thread_id.title: Thread Id
thread_id.description: Continue a thread the server issued (from `run_started`); 404 if this user has no runs in it. Omit to start a new thread.

lang.title: Lang
lang.description: Language for the answer text (BCP 47, e.g. 'en', 'zh-Hant', 'yue'). Stored on the run; answers are English until translation lands.

RunRequest.title: RunRequest
RunRequest.description: Start a run: a question, optionally about an area or saved place, in a thread.

RunStarted.title: RunStarted
RunStarted.description: The run has been accepted and started.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: UTC. After this the link answers 410.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: UTC. After this the link answers 410.

ShareInfo.title: ShareInfo
ShareInfo.description: A share link as listed to its owner.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the run was made. UTC.

shared_at.title: Shared At
shared_at.description: When the snapshot was taken. UTC.

SharedRun.title: SharedRun
SharedRun.description:
What a share link shows: a copy of the run taken when it was shared.

Deliberately left out: user id, thread id, the event log, params (they hold clarification
answers, which may come from place memory), the script, and any place memory.

SkillRef.title: SkillRef
SkillRef.description: A skill used by the method, pinned to a version.

Step.title: Step
Step.description: A visible reasoning step as stored on the run.

TimelineSeries.title: TimelineSeries
TimelineSeries.description: An extra line, e.g. the surroundings for local-vs-regional.

saved.title: Saved
saved.description: When the remembered value was saved.

ValueSource.title: ValueSource
ValueSource.description: Where a prefilled clarification value came from.
